name: Kokiri Sword
obtain: Chest in the hidden grove in Kokiri Forest (cut through the hollow log)
effect: Child Link's starting sword

name: Master Sword
obtain: Temple of Time pedestal, after gathering all 3 Spiritual Stones and the Ocarina of Time
effect: Adult Link's default blade; guards the Sacred Realm

name: Giant's Knife
obtain: Goron City shop, 200 rupees
effect: Powerful two-handed weapon that breaks after repeated hits
notes: Breaks into the 'Broken Goron's Sword' — first link in the trading sequence

name: Biggoron's Sword
obtain: Final reward of the trading sequence (Biggoron, Death Mountain)
effect: The strongest weapon in the game — two-handed and never breaks

name: Deku Shield
obtain: Kokiri Shop, 40 rupees
effect: Basic block; burns up when exposed to fire

name: Hylian Shield
obtain: Castle Town Market Bazaar, 80 rupees
effect: Fire-resistant; works for both child and adult Link

name: Mirror Shield
obtain: Chest inside the Spirit Temple (adult Link)
effect: Reflects light beams — required for the Spirit Temple and the Twinrova fight

name: Goron Tunic
obtain: Goron City shop, 200 rupees
effect: Immunity to extreme heat — required for the Crater and the Fire Temple

name: Zora Tunic
obtain: Gift from King Zora after melting the red ice with Blue Fire (or buy it beforehand for 300 rupees at the Zora shop)
effect: Lets you breathe and swim freely underwater

name: Iron Boots
obtain: Chest in the Ice Cavern, near Zora's Fountain
effect: Sink underwater and resist wind and knockback

name: Hover Boots
obtain: Chest inside the Shadow Temple
effect: Briefly hover over gaps and traps

name: Fairy Slingshot
obtain: Chest inside the Deku Tree
effect: Child Link's ranged weapon

name: Boomerang
obtain: Chest inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
effect: Stuns enemies and retrieves items from a distance

name: Bomb Bag
obtain: Chest inside Dodongo's Cavern
effect: Lets you carry and use bombs

name: Fairy Bow
obtain: Chest inside the Forest Temple
effect: Adult Link's ranged weapon; later loads Fire, Ice, and Light Arrows

name: Megaton Hammer
obtain: Chest inside the Fire Temple
effect: Smashes boulders and slams heavy switches

name: Hookshot
obtain: Reward for Dampé's grave-digging race, Kakariko Graveyard (under 1 minute)
effect: Pulls you toward wooden targets

name: Longshot
obtain: Chest in the Water Temple, after defeating Dark Link
effect: Twice the range of the regular Hookshot

name: Lens of Truth
obtain: Reward for defeating Dead Hand at the Bottom of the Well
effect: Reveals invisible walls, platforms, and enemies (drains magic)

name: Magic Meter
obtain: Great Fairy in Hyrule Field (bombable wall by the castle moat)
effect: Powers magic items and attacks (Lens of Truth, spin charge, elemental arrows)

name: Magic Beans
obtain: Traveling salesman by Zora's River, 10 rupees each
effect: Plant in soft soil, water it, and come back later for a climbable beanstalk

name: Bottle
obtain: Minigame and sidequest rewards (fishing, Cucco race, Ruto's letter, hollow-tree fairies…)
effect: Holds potions, fairies, water, bugs, or milk — up to 4 different bottles
